name: Camping 101: Mining

angles.text: As a miner, you can shape rough stone into a camp lodestone that aids travelers on the road and strengthens frontline fighters.
As an Alliance traveler, you can find Kurdram Stonehammer in Auberdine on the shores of Darkshore. He teaches campcraft to those passing through northern Kalimdor.

aliases: what do i do camping mining
faq.answer: You’re sent to Auberdine to find Kurdram Stonehammer. Once you show your mining skill, he teaches you to make a lodestone that strengthens a camp.
Kurdram Stonehammer is a craftsman in Auberdine on the coast of Darkshore. He teaches qualified miners to make camping gear, including lodestones.
Miners craft a camp lodestone to set beside a campfire. It strengthens physical fighters gathered nearby.
Auberdine is a coastal port in Darkshore, an Alliance harbor and crossroads in northern Kalimdor. Kurdram Stonehammer lives there and teaches miners campcraft.
faq.q: Where does this quest take place?

faq.answer: Close-quarters fighters especially value a camp lodestone. Its power gives travelers gathered around the fire greater vigor in combat.
faq.q: Who benefits from a camp lodestone?

faq.answer: Kurdram Stonehammer teaches lodestone crafting once you show sufficient skill in mining.
faq.q: When can you learn to craft the lodestone?

sections.body: Mining has uses beyond smelting ingots and hammering armor. Experienced prospectors shape raw earth and magnetic ore into camping gear, so travelers can make well-fortified hearths in the wilderness. This introduction shows miners a practical use for their craft.
sections.title: The Practical Art of Earth and Stone

sections.body: In Auberdine, the coastal town of Darkshore, promising miners seek out Kurdram Stonehammer. Once a miner proves dedication and skill, Kurdram teaches the method for making a camp lodestone. Set beside a fire, the stone strengthens the martial companions gathered nearby.
sections.title: A Mentor in Auberdine

summary: You’re sent to Auberdine to learn a new use for mining. There, Kurdram Stonehammer teaches skilled miners to craft a lodestone that strengthens allies gathered around a campfire.
